set.body: Delivered 2026-09-17: RepetitionDesign.withinParticipant constructs explicit directed matched/control relations across distinct occasions with ordinary keyed finite-cap selection; RepetitionResult retains edge analyses and typed failure-policy contrasts. A pinned public eyesim cosine fixture measures phase-only cross-participant grouping, pairwise/reduced rows, duplicates, singleton and empty cases against independent rational expectations. The compiled guide admits fixation CSV, saves/restores an exhaustive two-phase StudyPlan, executes and exports tidy results; JVM/Scala.js tests compare it to direct composition. Remaining acceptance: cover the rest of the required repetitive_similarity method matrix and multiscale mean/none behavior, and persist arbitrary all-occasion projections plus finite-cap controls with named schemas and direct-versus-restored pair/provenance proof. Keep participant, stimulus, occasion, self-edge policy and realized denominators explicit. Existing verified cosine evidence is not broad method parity. See docs/REPETITION_STUDIES.md and tools/r-parity/baseline.json; the broad repetition-and-reinstatement gap remains open.
set.title: Complete repetition method breadth and arbitrary-design persistence
